title: Guided Differentiation of Mature Kidney Podocytes from Human Induced Pluripotent Stem Cells Under Chemically Defined Conditions
protocol: Dilute thawed 5x hiPS cell culture media supplement in hiPS cell culture basal medium to obtain a 1x solution of hiPS CCM.
Slowly thaw frozen 5x hiPS CCM supplement overnight at 4°C.
Aliquot the prepared 1x hiPS CCM and store for up to 6 months at -20°C.
Thaw BM matrix 1 overnight on ice at 4°C.
Prepare aliquots of BM matrix 1 as suggested by the manufacturer.
Dilute BM matrix 1 in cold DMEM/F12, mixing thoroughly to avoid crystal formation.
Transfer 1 mL of BM matrix 1 solution to each well of a 6-well plate.
Incubate the BM matrix 1-coated plates at 37°C for 1-2 hours or at 4°C for at least 24 hours.
Wrap the BM matrix 1-coated plates in paraffin film during incubation.
Store BM matrix 1-coated plates at 4°C for up to 2 weeks.
Dilute appropriate amounts of BM matrix 2 in 9 mL sterile distilled water to prepare a final concentration of 5 μg/mL.
Add 700 μL of the BM matrix 2 solution to each well of a 12 well plate.
Incubate the plate at room temperature for 2 h or overnight at 4 °C.
Reconstitute BMP7 in sterile distilled water containing 0.1% (wt/vol) BSA.
Prepare 100 µg/mL stock solutions of Activin A and VEGF separately in sterile PBS containing 0.1% (wt/vol) BSA.
Aliquot 100 μL from each BMP7, Activin A, and VEGF stock solution and store at -20 °C for up to 6 months.
Dissolve 10 mg of Y27632 in 3.079 mL of sterile distilled water to prepare a 10 mM stock solution.
Aliquot 100 μL from the Y27632 stock and store at -20 °C for up to 6 months.
Dissolve 2 mg of CHIR99021 in 143.4 µL of sterile DMSO to prepare a 30 mM stock solution.
Prepare 5 μL aliquots from the CHIR99021 stock and store at -20 °C for up to 1 month or according to the manufacturer’s recommendation.
Dissolve 10 mg of all-trans retinoic acid in 3.33 mL sterile DMSO to prepare a stock solution.
Prepare 500 μL aliquots from the all-trans retinoic acid stock and store at -20 °C for up to 6 months.
Reconstitute stock solutions to a final concentration of 100 ng/mL Activin A, 3 µM CHIR99021, 10 µM Y27632, and 1x B27 serum-free supplement in DMEM/12 with glutamine.
Prepare the mesoderm differentiation medium for two 12 well plates using approximately 50 mL of medium.
Reconstitute stock solutions to a final concentration of 100 ng/mL BMP7, 3 µM CHIR99021, and 1x B27 serum-free supplement in DMEM/F12 with glutamine.
Optionally, supplement the intermediate mesoderm differentiation medium with 1% Penicillin-Streptomycin.
Store prepared medium in smaller aliquots of 45 mL in 50 mL conical tubes to avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles.
Keep stored medium at -20 °C for up to 3 months and thaw overnight at 4 °C before use if needed.

Reconstitute stock solutions to a final concentration of 100 ng/mL BMP7, 100 ng/mL activin A, 50 ng/mL VEGF, 3 µM CHIR99021, 1x B27 serum-free supplement, and 0.1 µM all-trans retinoic acid in DMEM/F12 with glutamine.
Protect the podocyte induction medium from light during preparation (e.g., by wrapping container with foil paper).
Aspirate the residual BM matrix solution from pre-coated plates.
Wash wells three times with warmed DMEM/F12.
Aspirate spent hiPS CCM from the hiPS cells.
Rinse cells three times with warmed DMEM/F12.
Add 1 ml of warm cell detachment solution and incubate for 1 min at 37°C.
Perform visual inspection of cells under a tissue culture microscope to ensure rounded edges of cell colonies.
Aspirate the cell detachment solution from the cells quickly.
Gently rinse cells once with DMEM/F12 to remove the cell detachment solution.
Add 3 mL of hiPS CCM to the hiPS cells in each well of a 6-well plate.
Scrape colonies using a cell lifter.
Gently pipette cell suspension up and down to dislodge loosely adhered cells.
Wash the plate thoroughly to ensure all cells are harvested.
Transfer 0.5 mL of cell suspension into each well of a new BM matrix 1-coated 6-well plate containing 2 mL of hiPS CCM per well.
Move the plate in figure-eight fashion to distribute cell colonies within wells.
Incubate at 37 °C in a 5% CO₂ incubator.
Refresh medium daily until cells reach approximately 70% confluency.
Visually inspect hiPS cell cultures for spontaneously differentiated cells.
Aseptically scrape off areas of differentiation if necessary.
Aspirate hiPS CCM from hiPS cells.
Rinse the cells 3 times with warm DMEM/F12.
Incubate cells with 1 mL enzyme-free cell dissociation buffer at 37°C for 10 min.
Check for cell dissociation under a microscope.
Gently scrape well with a cell lifter to dislodge loosely adhered cells.
Transfer cell suspension to a 15 mL conical tube.
Pipette up and down several times to individualize hiPS cells.
Bring cell suspension to 15 mL volume with warm DMEM/F12.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 290 x g at room temperature.
Gently aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend cells with warm DMEM/F12.
Perform another round of centrifugation to remove residual BM matrix and dissociation buffer components.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL of mesoderm induction medium.
Count the total number of cells using a hemocytometer or coulter counter.
Aspirate ECM solution from BM matrix 2-coated plates.
Rinse the plates twice with warm DMEM/F12.
Mix hiPS cell suspension gently by pipetting.
Transfer 1 mL of cell suspension to each well of BM matrix 2-coated 12-well plates.
Gently shake the plates to distribute cells evenly.
Incubate the plate at 37 °C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Refresh mesoderm induction medium the next day.
Aspirate mesoderm induction medium on day 2 of differentiation protocol.
Replenish with 1 mL per well intermediate mesoderm induction medium.
Refresh medium every day to maintain accurate growth factor and small molecule levels.
Increase volume of intermediate mesoderm differentiation medium to 1.3 mL if media nutrients are depleted.
Culture cells for additional 14 days to obtain intermediate mesoderm cells.
Rinse the intermediate mesoderm cells with warm DMEM/F12.
Incubate cells with 0.5 mL per well of 0.05% trypsin-EDTA for 3 min at 37°C.
Perform visual inspection to ensure that the cells are beginning to dissociate.
Scrape cells using a cell lifter and pipette the cell suspension several times using a 1,000 µL pipette tip to obtain individualized (or small clumps of) cells.
Add about 2 mL per well of trypsin neutralizing solution to stop the activity of trypsin.
Transfer cells to a 50 mL conical tube and bring the volume up to 50 mL using DMEM/F12, and then centrifuge the cell suspension for 5 min at 201 x g at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend cells in podocyte induction medium.
Ensure a final seeding density of approximately 100,000 cells/well of a 12 well plate.
Add the cell suspension to BM matrix 2-coated plates and gently shake the plate to help distribute the cells more evenly.
Incubate cells at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Refresh medium daily for up to 5 days to obtain podocytes by day 21.
